name: Whisky Poker
description: Whisky Poker is a poker-style game with widow hand exchange. Multiple players. 5 each + 5-card widow. Options: swap entire hand for widow (old hand becomes new widow face-up), swap 1 card with widow, or knock (triggers final round). Last best poker hand after knock wins. Worst hand pays chip.

history.origins: Whisky Poker is an American commerce game based on poker hand rankings but with a different mechanism: improving hands by exchanging with a common table hand (the widow). It appears in many late 19th- and early 20th-century North American card game books and is less well known today. A version remains popular in Mexico as La Viuda (the widow).
timeline: Late 19th–early 20th century: Documented in North American card game books.
history.evolution: One of many widow poker games.

setup.deck: Standard 52-card pack without jokers; one deck for all player counts (2 to 9).

rules.objective: Collect the best five-card poker hand by exchanging cards with the spare hand (widow) on the table. In standard play the best hand wins the pool; in the alternative form the worst hand pays one chip and the first to lose all chips pays for refreshments.
rules.gameplay: Each turn: swap entire hand for widow (discards become face-up widow), swap 1 card, or knock. After knock = 1 final round. Showdown: standard poker rankings. Worst hand pays 1 chip. Out of chips = eliminated.

strategy.basic: Take widow if hand is very weak.

variations.name: La Viuda
variations.description: Mexican variant: 52 cards plus two jokers (wild); counter-clockwise play; wild card determined by number of chips in pool; optional extra chip La Viuda to re-enter after losing all chips.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: La Viuda differs in deck (jokers), direction and chip rules; overrides to be added when implementing variant.

scoring.description: Standard poker rankings. Worst pays chip.
scoring.winCondition: Best 5-card poker hand. Don't be worst.
